atlas:
Use case: stylized-concept / style-transfer. Asset: tiny post-apocalyptic tabletop inventory glyphs. Create ONE square atlas with exactly 7 active glyphs in NINE equal cells, a 3x3 grid in strict ROW-MAJOR order. No visible grid, no cell labels. PURE SOLID WHITE #FFFFFF glyphs on perfectly clean PURE BLACK #000000. Match the reference's broad sober stencil silhouettes and restrained large black negative-space cuts. Keep every complete subject in the middle 60% of its cell with at least 20% blank margin on ALL FOUR sides. No mark or body part may cross cell boundaries. All heads, wrists, fingers, tool handles, vehicles and barrels remain complete. These must read at 16/24/32 px: simplify details rather than draw a miniature illustration. NO grey shading, gradients, hatching, dithering, distressed edges, speckles, thin wrinkles, hair strands, readable text, initials, numerals, logos, borders or watermark. NO anime, manga, chibi, spiky hair, huge eyes, heroic pretty faces or cartoon anatomy. Do NOT default to repeated bearded gruff male survivor portraits: use the actual objects, gestures or generic adult action silhouettes requested below. Human figures have natural adult proportions and minimal or featureless faces; generic abilities need no gender stereotype. No gore. No playful arrows, giant generic cogs or floating toy fragments.
